name: Villamayor (Spain)
description: Square white flag charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Villamayor (a stone block on yellow and tools on green).
history: The arms of Villamayor were published in the Boletín Oficial del Estado on 15 November 1997; the municipal flag was approved on 7 May 1998 and is square, of silver throughout with the council's own arms over all.

features.role: Villamayor arms — stone block on yellow and stonemason's tools on green
